preconditions.description: The number of members n is between 3 and 150,000 inclusive.
The number of friendship pairs m is between 0 and the maximum possible number of unique pairs of members.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in friendships)
preconditions.description: Each friendship pair (ai, bi) consists of distinct members within the range 1 to n.
The number of friendship pairs in the input matches the given m.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if all(any((x, z) in friendships or (z, x) in friendships for x, z in combinations([a, b, c], 2)) for a, b, c in combinations(range(1, n + 1), 3) if (a, b) in friendships or (b, a) in friendships and (b, c) in friendships or (c, b) in friendships) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if for every three distinct members (X, Y, Z), if X-Y and Y-Z then also X-Z; otherwise, the output is 'NO'.
